title: Amayengo Agaagabanya Omusaayi
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’amataba amanene ennyo gasituka ku nsi, Essanduuko ng’etengejja nga tekyukakyuka, n’omwoyo gumu ogwalekebwa ebweru olw’okulonda. Ng’asibiddwa omusaayi eri nnabbi naye nga yayawukana olw’enzikiriza, ffiga eno yayolekedde okuyitibwa okusembayo okulinnya ku lyato ng’amazzi gakulukuta. Osobola okuzuula ekituufu ekiri emabega w’okugaana?
clues: Ndi zzadde ly’omu ku bannabbi ba Allah abakulu, amaka ag’okukkiriza ge nnalonda okulekawo.
Nnabeera mu kiseera ky’Amataba Amanene, ng’obutakkiriza bubikka ensi ng’amazzi.
Nagaana okulinnya Ssanduuko n’abakkiriza taata bwe yankubira essanduuko.
Nagamba nti nja kunoonya obuddukiro ku lusozi okunkuuma amazzi.
Nategeezebwa nti tewali kiyinza kukuuma kiragiro kya Allah ku lunaku olwo okujjako okusaasira.
Amayengo ne gankwata ne nfiira mu mazzi, era taata ne bategeezebwa nti siri wa mu maka ge abatuukirivu.

identity.label: Nze Ani?
options: Zayd ibn Harithah, omuwandiisi w’ebitabo
Nabbi Ishaq, Mutabani wa Nabbi Ibrahim
Omwana wa Nabbi Nuh Omutakkiriza
Habil, Mutabani wa Nabbi Adam
Nabbi Ismail, Mutabani wa Nabbi Ibrahim

Okugaana okulinnya Ssanduuko n’okunoonya olusozi ng’ekiddukiro
Okusuulibwa mu muliro ogwaka olw’okumenya ebifaananyi
Okumira ekyennyanja ekinene oluvannyuma lw’okudduka emisomo
Okwebaka okumala ebyasa bingi mu mpuku okusobola okuwona okuyigganyizibwa
trial.answer: Okugaana okulinnya Ssanduuko n’okunoonya olusozi ng’ekiddukiro

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
